# SMS Webhook

> SMS Webhook is a free Android app by Best Caller that forwards the SMS a phone receives to the user's own webhook or HTTP API over HTTPS, in real time. No account, no ads, no analytics; the developer never receives message content.

Package: com.bestcallerapp.smswebhook · Version 1.0.0 · Android 8.0+ · Free · Publisher: Best Caller (Bengaluru, India) · Contact: smswebhook@bestcallerapp.com

Key facts:
- Forwards incoming SMS only (permission RECEIVE_SMS). It does not read the existing inbox, send SMS, or forward RCS/WhatsApp.
- Multiple webhooks, each with its own filters: sender, message text, keywords (ANY/ALL), regex, SIM slot, length, time of day; combined with AND / OR / NOT.
- Payload formats: JSON with chosen and renamed fields, custom JSON template ({{sender}}, {{message}}, {{timestamp}}…), plain text, form data.
- Regex capture groups extract values such as amount, OTP or account number into their own fields.
- Custom headers, Bearer token, Basic auth, API-key headers; secrets encrypted with Android Keystore.
- Reliable delivery: messages stored on the phone first, offline queue, background jobs, exponential-backoff retries, duplicate detection, X-Idempotency-Key header.
- Message history and delivery logs with HTTP status, response and attempts; one-tap retry.
- Typical uses: payment/UPI/bank alert reconciliation in a backend, OTP relay for QA and test automation, CRM logging, Zapier / n8n / Make workflows.

## Docs
- [Home](https://smswebhook.bestcallerapp.com/): overview, features, FAQ
- [How-to guide](https://smswebhook.bestcallerapp.com/guide/): all tutorials
- [Getting started](https://smswebhook.bestcallerapp.com/guide/getting-started/): Set up SMS Webhook on Android: install the app, allow the Receive SMS permission, and keep SMS forwarding running reliably in the background.
- [Add a webhook](https://smswebhook.bestcallerapp.com/guide/add-a-webhook/): Step by step: add a webhook in SMS Webhook, enter your HTTPS endpoint, choose which SMS to forward and the payload format, then send a test.
- [Message filters](https://smswebhook.bestcallerapp.com/guide/filters/): Forward only the SMS you need: match sender IDs, keywords (any or all), regex, SIM slot, length and time of day, combined with AND, OR and NOT.
- [Payload formats](https://smswebhook.bestcallerapp.com/guide/payloads/): Send SMS to your API as JSON with your own field names, a custom JSON template, plain text or form data, and pick exactly which fields are sent.
- [Extract values with regex](https://smswebhook.bestcallerapp.com/guide/regex-extraction/): Use regex capture groups to pull an OTP, amount, account number or any value out of an SMS and send it as its own JSON field, with a live preview.
- [Headers and authentication](https://smswebhook.bestcallerapp.com/guide/headers-and-authentication/): Secure your SMS webhook with a Bearer token, Basic auth, API-key or custom headers. Secret values are encrypted on the phone and hidden in logs.
- [Delivery, retries and offline](https://smswebhook.bestcallerapp.com/guide/delivery-and-retries/): How SMS Webhook delivers every message: stored on the phone first, queued while offline, retried with backoff, and sent with an idempotency key.
- [History and delivery logs](https://smswebhook.bestcallerapp.com/guide/history-and-logs/): Search forwarded SMS, see which webhooks matched, every attempt, HTTP status and response, and retry failed deliveries with one tap.
- [Settings, retention and backup](https://smswebhook.bestcallerapp.com/guide/settings/): Choose how long SMS history is kept, set delivery defaults, view logs, and export or import your webhook settings with or without secrets.
- [Receive webhooks on your server](https://smswebhook.bestcallerapp.com/guide/receive-on-your-server/): What SMS Webhook sends to your endpoint, how to respond and handle retries safely, with ready-to-use examples in Node.js, Python and PHP.
- [Troubleshooting](https://smswebhook.bestcallerapp.com/guide/troubleshooting/): Fix common problems: SMS not received or not forwarded, failed or slow webhook deliveries, HTTP errors, and regex that doesn't match.
